name: Prismskin Reactive Geneware Night Drape
description: A Tier 3 mid-level night-out statement built around geneware visibility — specifically designed for wearers with tails, bioluminescent skin patches, or decorative horns, presenting those modifications as the primary aesthetic focus rather than accommodating them as afterthoughts. The main garment is a floor-length open drape in reactive holographic mesh — a sheer, weightless fabric that shifts between deep violet, mirror-silver, and warm rose-gold depending on angle and ambient light, with embedded micro-LEDs threaded through every third strand that respond to the wearer's own bioluminescent output frequency. Where the wearer glows, the fabric amplifies. The drape falls open at the front, worn over a fitted bodysuit in matte black adaptive stretch — seamless, with a reinforced tail-port opening at the lower back finished in chrome grommet trim, and horn-clearance collar cut wide and low to frame rather than constrain. Beneath the drape, the bodysuit is close enough to read every line of chrome or scale underneath. Strappy sandals in translucent synth-resin with embedded amber light strips complete the foot. A single wide cuff in reactive holographic mesh worn at one wrist ties the drape to the body with an anchor point. The total effect in a dark club is something between a walking aurora and a controlled detonation.
functionality: Bioluminescent response mesh amplifies and echoes the wearer's own light output. Tail-port opening at lower back with chrome grommet finish accommodates all standard geneware tail configurations. Wide horn-clearance collar accommodates standard to large decorative horn sets. Adaptive stretch bodysuit conforms to non-standard body proportions including synthetic builds. Drape is detachable at wrist cuff anchor for quick removal.
what_it_says: You paid for your geneware and you want every person in this room to understand exactly what it cost — not in credits, in commitment. You are not hiding anything. The light is the point.
worn_by: mid-level professionals who save for weekend transformation
synthetic individuals with aesthetic light augmentation
manufacturer: Prismweave Studio — Tier 3 independent atelier, small-batch production, takes custom geneware measurements
story_hooks: The micro-LED frequency response in this drape is supposed to sync only to the wearer's own bioluminescent signature — but in the club, it begins resonating with someone else across the room, someone the wearer has never met, whose biolum signature should be genetically unique.

A Prismweave Studio piece is identified by a Tier 5 lawyer as part of an estate dispute — the reactive mesh design was allegedly based on stolen proprietary fabric patents, and every person wearing one may be implicated as unwitting evidence.

The wearer is approached by a Shelf runner who claims the chrome grommet trim on their tail-port opening contains a hidden data cache — pressed there by a Prismweave employee who needed a dead drop and had access to the production line.
